text: In the kingdom of Economica, stagnation reigned until Queen Analytica introduced the invisible forces of supply and demand. As citizens engaged in commerce, their daily lives became an allegory for market equilibriums, shortages, and surpluses, making abstract fiscal policies accessible to all. Just as the kingdom required a steady flow of resources to thrive, the human body relies on a central organ to pump blood, ensuring that every cell receives the oxygen and nutrients necessary for life.
